spaces.label: Multi-step public service journey
goodFit: A journey has a start, finish and useful task order across services.
poorFit: Users only read guidance, or choices have no useful order.
superficialDoNotBorrow: GOV.UK visual styling, departmental names and exact step wording

spaces.label: Revision-aware editorial record
goodFit: Content changes matter for editorial accountability or recovery.
poorFit: A transient draft has no need for retained public revision history.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Wiki page chrome, minor-edit letter and contributor-name layout

spaces.label: Exception-led production coordination
goodFit: Work has detectable defects and an accountable responder can intervene.
poorFit: Stopping work would create greater harm, or no one can assess the signal.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Factory rope, andon board appearance and Toyota process terminology

spaces.label: Pause-and-inspect diagnostic instrument
goodFit: A process can be paused safely and state at that point is informative.
poorFit: Real-time or safety-critical action cannot tolerate a pause.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Red breakpoint icon, keyboard shortcuts and editor panel layout

spaces.label: Visible production dependency simulation
goodFit: Learning or planning benefits from experimenting with resource flow.
poorFit: The real domain has constraints the simulation cannot represent honestly.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Pixel art, game recipes, item names and progression rewards

spaces.label: Bounded transaction handoff
goodFit: A payment flow has a clear order and requires specialized collection.
poorFit: There is no payment transaction or handoff to a payment provider.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Stripe branding, exact form styling and upsell presentation

spaces.label: Topic-anchored conversation
goodFit: Several topics progress concurrently and replies need local context.
poorFit: An urgent update must reliably reach everyone in the channel.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Slack icons, emoji reactions and channel color treatment

spaces.label: Typed conceptual navigation
goodFit: People search or browse a concept scheme with different relation types.
poorFit: The information has no defensible hierarchy or associative taxonomy.
superficialDoNotBorrow: SKOS namespace syntax, example letters and diagram styling

spaces.label: Object-first exploration
goodFit: People need to browse, compare, return to, and act on identifiable objects.
poorFit: There is only one implicit object or a fixed one-off procedure with no useful collection.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Book covers, exact bookshelf layout, labels, and teamLab visual styling

spaces.label: Decision-focused object comparison
goodFit: Candidates share comparable attributes and the user must scan or compare several at once.
poorFit: Objects lack stable comparable fields, or rich spatial/visual context determines the choice.
superficialDoNotBorrow: SmartHR labels, icons, colors, sample data, and exact table layout

spaces.label: Function-led visual emphasis
goodFit: One action is clearly primary at a particular task moment and users must find it quickly.
poorFit: Several actions are equally important, or the domain calls for calm, familiar scanning.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Google brand palette, expressive shapes, email content, and experimental screen compositions

spaces.label: Hierarchical run progress with detail on demand
goodFit: Work has real nested stages and users need to see where execution is waiting or failing.
poorFit: The work is instantaneous or stages do not correspond to meaningful user-visible progress.
superficialDoNotBorrow: GitHub iconography, job names, exact Actions sidebar, and green/yellow status styling

spaces.label: Optional explanation after the primary decision
goodFit: The same core decision is possible without opening one short explanation.
poorFit: The majority needs the information, or several sections must be navigated.
superficialDoNotBorrow: GOV.UK styling, wording, icon, exact markup, and sample text

spaces.label: Resume-oriented multi-task progress
goodFit: A transaction spans several user tasks or sessions and a person must resume reliably.
poorFit: A journey can be simplified to one pass or its internal stages are not meaningful user actions.
superficialDoNotBorrow: GOV.UK styling, status labels, exact task order, and sample content

spaces.label: Warm brand core with restrained support roles
goodFit: An approved character calls for warmth and recognizability across frequent work contexts.
poorFit: Brand intent is reserved or technical, or the warm cue collides with task states.
superficialDoNotBorrow: kintone yellow, exact ratios, layouts, and artwork

spaces.label: Signature brand moments on a restrained canvas
goodFit: A brand has recognizable equity or a clear rationale for selective signature emphasis.
poorFit: No brand character is agreed or persistent color is needed to orient between contexts.
superficialDoNotBorrow: YouTube red, magenta gradient, video imagery, and exact component styling

spaces.label: Purpose-based UI color roles
goodFit: Multiple screens and states reuse color meanings across components.
poorFit: A single decorative asset has no reusable product state system to govern.
superficialDoNotBorrow: SmartHR palette values, labels, CSS tokens and HR-specific status semantics

spaces.label: Layered neutral utility surfaces
goodFit: A screen has genuinely nested panels, forms or diagnostics that need containment cues.
poorFit: A shallow interface gains no clarity from multiple surface layers.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Carbon exact grays, four-layer quota, component code and artwork
